messages:
Rashid (security): FYI - discovery: a vuln scanner flagged that a transitive dep used by svc-backup-exporter exposes an unauthenticated metrics endpoint. We want to reduce blast radius by pruning admin-level grants from exporter prefix tomorrow 09:30 PT for a short canary. Need quick ack from infra + owners.
Ellen (infra): can we limited-scope the change? I'm worried about KMS operations during the window.
Diego (eng): agree. If exporter calls KMS for envelope encryption, removing admin roles may break rotates. We need KMS usage proof.
audit-bot: Ingestion status: kms-audit-stream delayed for cluster backup-cluster-2. Last event processed: 1789998600. Backfill ETA: 40m. (ticket: audit-4321)
Rashid (security): thanks. New plan: run a non-KMS prune that revokes admin IAM roles but leaves KMS grants untouched. We'll also snapshot current KMS key metadata and enable extra logging.
Sasha (sre): I can take monitoring. Proposed quick checks: 
- smoke backup job run (backup-runner) succeeds within 20m
- exporter metrics don't show auth failures >5%
- no increase in infra-alerts noise
Diego (eng): how do we list current KMS usage so we know pruning didn't change crypto ops?
Ellen (infra): run: `internal-kmsctl usage --key backup/primary --since 1h` should show active handles. Also `./tools/iam-diff --prefix svc-backup-exporter` for planned revokes.
Rashid (security): paste minimal iam-diff output: 
``nsvc-backup-exporter: ADMIN -> account:prod-backup@acct-888 (owner: team-data)
svc-backup-exporter-telemetry: ADMIN -> account:prod-backup@acct-777 (ownerless)
``n
Diego (eng): exporter-telemetry is ownerless. We should open an ownership ticket rather than touching it.
Nina (product): tagging product for impact - exporter telemetry powers usage dashboards. Can we avoid touching telemetry grants?
Rashid (security): yes - plan updated: exclude telemetry svc-acct from phase1. Phase1 = revoke ADMIN on core exporter only (non-telemetry), verify 2h. Phase2 = revisit telemetry and KMS grants after audit backfill.
oncall: if ownership ticket is created without assignee, I will accept temporary ownership for 48h.
Ellen (infra): I'll own the KMS snapshot and gating. If audit stream isn't healthy by 09:30, we hold phase2.
Sasha (sre): monitoring run schedule: T+10m, T+60m, T+120m. Rollback criteria: any backup job failure, any auth-related 4xx/5xx spike >3x baseline, or KMS usage drop >30%.
audit-bot: Canary job scheduled: lite-prune-1789998888 at 09:30 PT. Job id: prune-lite-1789998888. Will post diff and results here.
Diego (eng): please include the exact revoke command in the preflight msg. Also add a dry-run output.
Rashid (security): preflight will include dry-run output and a one-line revert command. Example revert: `./tools/iam-apply --restore prune-lite-1789998888.backup`
Nina (product): ack. Please ping product-channel when phase1 completes. We have stakeholders watching.
Rashid (security): action items summary: 1) exclude telemetry + KMS grants from phase1; 2) Ellen snapshots KMS metadata & watches ingestion; 3) Diego prepares dry-run and revert; 4) Sasha runs monitoring and executes rollback if criteria met; 5) oncall picks up temp ownership if ticket unclaimed. Will post preflight 30m before go.
Sasha (sre): acked.
Ellen (infra): ack, will update ticket audit-4321 if anything changes.
oncall: standing by for ownership ack.
